coverageAreas.area: Word portrait and landscape keyboard layout
Landscape slide editing and presentation exit

cases.title: Login and portrait workspace
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Configure the loopback service and sign in to the isolated QA account; verify three document kinds and the 3 GB indicator.

cases.title: Word portrait and landscape keyboard layout
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Enter Tablet QA. Show the software keyboard and rotate to landscape; caret, document and toolbar remain visible. Server readback confirms exact text.

cases.title: Landscape spreadsheet formula and save
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Enter =120+80 through the formula bar, observe A1=200 and save. Server readback preserves the formula. Software keyboard geometry for sheets was not tested.

cases.title: Landscape slide editing and presentation exit
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Replace the title with iPad QA, save, start presentation and close using the visible close control. Server readback confirms the title.

cases.title: Chinese composition and native clipboard
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Input automation encountered focus/composition limitations; no Chinese IME or clipboard acceptance claim.

cases.title: Split View and Stage Manager
preconditions: Task-owned iPad Air 11-inch (M3), iOS 26.1; local QA service on port 3173
steps: Full-screen simulator only; multi-window scenarios remain untested.
